description:
FILED s471 (Fable, 2026-09-06); design = docs/plan-cache-and-install-s471.md section 5.3 + 5.4 -- read it first.

RUNTIME: probe `podman` then `docker`; plan skip_all when neither is present (safe to write before the USER installs one; RULED podman rootless preferred, Docker acceptable).

RECIPE SPLIT (rule 11): tools/install-matrix/install-and-verify.sh -> deps.sh (apt, cpanm PPI, pinned SBCL binary, Quicklisp + cl-ppcre) + verify.sh (from tools/install-pcl on: runpcl hello, the utf8 source, prove tools/t/install-pcl.t); install-and-verify.sh becomes the two in sequence so .github/workflows/install-matrix.yml is unchanged in behaviour (diff its log before/after on one push).

IMAGE: build once from a stock ubuntu:24.04 (+ the matrix's other images as an option), tagged by a hash of deps.sh + SBCL_VERSION; reuse across runs (iterations ~30 s instead of the 2-3 min download).  The repo enters the container as a bind mount of a `git archive HEAD` extraction, never the live checkout.

LEGS: (a) verify.sh as root (= the matrix); (b) a NON-ROOT user (useradd), tools/install-pcl into $HOME/.local, the PATH line printed, `pcl -e` works from the user's shell; (c) SHARED install: root installs to /opt/pcl, the user runs `/opt/pcl/bin/pcl -e 'use List::Util qw(sum); print sum(1..3)'` with an EMPTY home -> prints 6 AND the module cache appears under the USER's home, nothing under /root (FAILS today, #1303); (d) after #1300: `pcl --cache-info` under (c) reports the user's cache dir and the default compile list.

BARS: each leg's assertions are Test::More rows with the container's output as diag; wall time reported; NOT in the gate (minutes); documented in CLAUDE.md Quick Reference beside tools/t/install-pcl.t.  Run before a tag.

UPDATE s471 (2026-09-06 ~09:10): the USER INSTALLED podman on the dev box -- the runtime leg is no longer hypothetical; the test still probes podman/docker and skips without either (CI runners without a socket).

=== DONE (s470bz) ===
tools/t/install-container.t, 17 rows, PASS.  COLD 87 s (image build 40 s),
WARM 47 s.  Legs: a=32 s, b=6 s, c+d=7-8 s.  NOT in the gate.

RECIPE SPLIT (rule 11): tools/install-matrix/install-and-verify.sh -> deps.sh
(apt, cpanm PPI, the pinned SBCL binary, Quicklisp + cl-ppcre) + verify.sh
(from tools/install-pcl on), with install-and-verify.sh now the two in sequence
and nothing else, so .github/workflows/install-matrix.yml's step invocation is
untouched.  Compared COMMAND FOR COMMAND against b5e9f845 (comments and blank
lines stripped, the two halves concatenated); every difference is deliberate:
`set -euo pipefail` and the three exports repeat because a child process is a
child process; PREFIX and the repo-root guard move to the half that uses them;
verify.sh picks up $HOME/sbcl/bin ITSELF, conditionally, because an exported
PATH does not cross between sibling scripts.  TWO are changes, not moves, and
both are declared: PPI_MIN is now EXPORTED (the floor check is a child perl
reading $ENV{PPI_MIN} -- unexported it compared against undef and could not
fail; the CI workflow sets it as a job env, which is why it worked there and
only there), and verify.sh runs `pcl /tmp/hello.pl` beside runpcl now that pcl
is installed.  verify.sh alone, run locally with PREFIX at a temp dir: PASS.
bash -n on all three.

RUNTIME PROBE: `podman info` then `docker info` (not --version: a CI runner can
have the client and no socket, and that must skip); plan skip_all naming both
when neither answers.  PCL_INSTALL_CONTAINER_SKIP=1 skips the whole file, and
the last row runs the file again under that variable and asserts the skip is
clean rather than trusting it.

IMAGE: ubuntu:24.04 + deps.sh, tagged pcl-install-base:<sha1(deps.sh +
Containerfile + SBCL_VERSION)[0,12]>, reused across runs.  deps.sh runs with
HOME=/opt/pcldeps (world-readable) rather than root's home, because the recipe
installs SBCL and Quicklisp under $HOME and the non-root legs need both -- the
same script, one variable different -- plus a /usr/local/bin/sbcl symlink, an
/etc/sbclrc, and `useradd -m pcluser`.

REPO: a `git archive HEAD` extraction bind-mounted READ-ONLY at /src, never the
live checkout, made world-readable because rootless podman maps the invoking
user to container root and every other container user to a subuid.  The test
therefore measures what is COMMITTED and diags when the tracked tree is dirty.

LEGS: (a) verify.sh as root = the matrix, one local run instead of a push per
attempt -- IT PASSES HERE, so the next push is not the first run; (b) pcluser
installs into $HOME/.local, is told the exact PATH line, and runs the installed
pcl from that user's shell; (c) root installs /opt/pcl and pcluser, with an
emptied home, runs `use List::Util qw(sum); print sum(1..3)` -> 6, with the
module cache under /home/pcluser and nothing new under /root; (d) the same
container's `pcl --cache-info` names THAT user's cache directory, the compile
policy, and /opt/pcl's core rather than a per-user cached one.  (c) and (d)
share one container and one core build: two questions about one installation.

IT FOUND A BUG ON ITS FIRST RUN.  Leg (c) died with "Can't create directory
/root/.cache": a saved PCL core memoises asdf:*user-cache* as the CORE
BUILDER's home, so ASDF work in another user's process targets a directory it
cannot write.  Reproduced with no container at all and filed as #1327 (the
#1303 family one layer out).  The image's /etc/sbclrc now loads Quicklisp only
`(unless (find-package "QUICKLISP-CLIENT"))` -- what any sysinit should say,
since a core that already has Quicklisp must not re-enter ASDF -- with a
comment naming #1327 and saying that removing the guard reproduces it.

Documented in CLAUDE.md's Quick Reference beside `prove tools/t/install-pcl.t`:
when to run it (before a tag, after any change to tools/install-pcl or
tools/install-matrix/*), the podman/docker rule, the image tag, and the
git-archive-HEAD rule.
subject: tools/t/install-container.t (USER ask 2026-09-06): the installer on a STOCK image, locally -- root / non-root / SHARED-install legs (the #1303 shape: core built by root under /opt, run by a user with an empty home); the CI recipe SPLIT into deps + verify halves shared with the matrix; skips without podman/docker
